tests.title: initial state offers merge pairs and an immediately fulfillable first order
merges matching items exactly once, records discoveries and leaves original state untouched
different chains and different levels swap without merging
moving to an empty cell preserves item count; identical max-level items stay intact
fulfillment consumes exact items, awards rewards and replaces one order
duplicate requirements cannot reuse items; fulfillment preserves surplus and unrelated items
invalid actions fail safely without changing game resources
generation requires both energy and a free cell and spends exactly one energy
energy regenerates per elapsed minute and preserves fractional progress
full energy discards idle-time credits and spending starts a fresh countdown
offline regeneration is applied before actions and energy remains capped
a backwards clock grants no energy and never makes the state timestamp invalid
refill and selling charge or award only for valid actions
hydration clones valid saves, removes unknown fields and restores offline energy
malformed and corrupted saves fall back to a valid fresh state
bounded counters never overflow and saved states remain hydratable after rewards
reset returns fresh independent state and all chain definitions have six levels
on-board generators spend one energy, stay intact and can move or swap without merging
order progress and fulfillment never count or consume generators or stored items
inventory stores and retrieves exact items without charging resources and enforces capacity
gem energy refills cost exactly five gems, cap energy and reject unavailable purchases
each quest is claimable only after its target and its reward cannot be collected twice
real v1 cafe saves migrate every item by row and preserve resources, order rewards and discoveries
migration accepts a completely full legacy board without losing items
v2 cafe migration preserves item indices, generator flags, inventory, quantities, rewards and claimed quests
a full v2 board never loses an item for a new generator and workshop-menu generation stays available
every traditional workshop generates its own materials with exactly one energy
replacement orders cycle through all 15 characters and all 10 craft chains
native progress takes priority over stale web storage
first native launch migrates old progress without deleting it
native read failure stops startup instead of replacing the save
rapid actions are written in order and flush awaits the latest action
a failed native write is reported and later saves still work
native saves work when browser storage is blocked
cached sprites respond immediately while a pending network request refreshes in the background
an image cache miss returns the network response and saves it for subsequent loads
unavailable cache storage does not prevent an image from loading over the network
a failed image refresh keeps the cached sprite available while offline
v4 exposes 84 items and unlocks eras and modern workshops at exact level thresholds
modern generators and exact-item purchases reject locked chains without spending resources
replacement orders use only available eras and reach all 14 chains at level ten
v3 saves keep all existing progress while travel and the current weekly pass start fresh
building construction respects levels and coins, charges once and awards its one-time reward
daily rewards persist through reload, use UTC midnight and do not reset on clock rollback
memory cards persist while a mismatch blocks more flips until the pair is hidden
completing memory pays only once per UTC day even after replay and reload
yut rolls keep position through reload, cap the finish at 12 and award once daily
album completion requires all six discoveries and rewards each chain only once
pass order count changes on fulfillment only and resets at Monday UTC
free and premium pass tracks enforce targets, spend 20 gems and award separate claims once
offers reject energy overflow before charging and enforce once-only or UTC daily limits
item purchases give one exact unlocked item, charge its level price and record discovery
invalid purchase quantities, tiers, levels, empty wallets and full boards never charge
invalid persisted travel state cannot inject duplicate claims, invalid decks or forged schemas
travel hydration clones nested arrays and strips fields outside the persisted schema
crossing an era boundary with an order reward unlocks the next era immediately
